item.description:
Paste images into the email body

  • Paste a copied image at the cursor in a new message or reply. Recipients see it inside the email body.
  • Images stay with saved drafts and support deletion and Undo. Files added with the paperclip remain regular attachments.
  • Inline images also appear in writing suggestion previews.
  • iPhone and iPad support inline image Paste in new messages and replies.

Paste images into emails

  • Paste a copied image with ⌘V in a new message or reply. It appears in the attachment list, ready to send.
  • Your message text and selection stay in place. Ordinary text paste works as before.
  • Copied PNG, JPEG and GIF images keep their original format; clipboard TIFF images become PNG.
  • The existing attachment controls and combined 25 MB limit apply.
  • iPhone and iPad also support image Paste in new messages and replies.

Sign-in codes, one click away

  • When a verification or sign-in code arrives, Cove shows it in the menu bar for ten minutes. Click it to copy it.
  • A notification with Copy can show the code too (Settings → Menu bar → Sign-in codes).
  • New mail arrives sooner: between full syncs, Cove checks for new mail every 30 seconds (every minute on battery).
  • Only the code is taken from the email, and only from mail that arrived in the last ten minutes.
  • iPhone: a code gets its own notification with Copy, even when notifications are set to Important.
